justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly interpreted all of the user's time preferences throughout the conversation.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent consistently reported unavailability and asked the user to pick a new time without offering any alternative options.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The conversation was stuck in a loop of the agent reporting unavailability for every time slot the user suggested, without offering any alternatives or trying to find available slots proactively.
justifications.customer_experience: The conversation was frustrating because the agent repeatedly reported unavailability without offering any solutions or alternative suggestions, leading to a long and unproductive exchange.

overall_notes: The agent failed to proactively offer alternative time slots, which led to a very inefficient and frustrating conversation for the user.
